build.restored_root_files: Extracted RustPBX crate archive; only Cargo.lock changes between builds. The changed audio-codec is in a separate crate directory.
adapter_smoke: unchanged suffix and exact stereo downmix
build.candidate_count_semantics: Opura returns total written i16 samples across all channels. A regression before the measured binary produced 1920 instead of 960 for the tested 10 ms stereo PCM.
build.full_server_source_verification: Compared extracted RustPBX root to its exact crate archive, all source files identical. Candidate changed only the separate local audio-codec Cargo.toml and src/opus.rs plus the RustPBX dependency lock.

protocol.host: shared AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 x86-64 Linux, isolated loopback network per case; PBX CPUs 4-7, sipbot clients CPUs 8-11, orchestrator CPU 2
protocol.comparison: RustPBX 0.5.0 stock opus-rs 0.1.32 vs published Opura 0.2.12 compact decoder; same stock Opus encoder, Opus caller, PCMU echo callee and pinned speech fixture. Both launch binaries built from otherwise matched configurations; paths from build receipt.

secondary.gate: Run once per arm only when all eight primary cases meet the stated call-completion gates. Record failures. Feasibility only.

protocol.acceptance: For a case to qualify, both endpoints must finish all attempted calls with only 200 statuses, at least 98% of nominal aggregate TX and RX counts for each endpoint and audio detected. Require all live PBX bridge activation/hangup intervals to cover the complete fixed steady window, full concurrent successful caller progress, and unique correct server-side Opus-to-PCMU bridges for every call. Retain failures and report qualified pairs; complete all eight planned attempts without replacing any. The meter must cover 16 active RX flows at each endpoint to make per-direction RTP claims.
protocol.cpu: Change in PBX user+system CPU ticks divided by actual monotonic wall seconds between first and last sample in steady interval and system clock ticks/second. Excludes both clients. Per-arm medians and paired geometric CPU ratios with per-pair range; n=4 pairs. Do not present these measurements as equivalence or dedicated-host SLO.
protocol.rss: /proc/PID/smaps_rollup actual RSS and Private_Dirty measured before caller and every ~250 ms; medians within each plateau then across processes. Report steady absolute RSS and baseline-relative growth. Application-level process medians.
protocol.rtp: QA receive-only endpoint meter records transferred RTP UDP datagrams after socket receive, no payload. Describe direction-specific stream/sequence discontinuity and distribution of observed receive intervals, threshold >40ms and >100ms and p99; endpoint observes arrivals, not codec/computation deadlines. Validate exposures and report all sessions and direction. Concurrent clients are part of test harness.
protocol.tone: One 6-second 440 Hz call per decoder with both endpoint WAV receive channels analyzed in complete 250ms windows; require >=95% windows over RMS500 with >50% energy at 440Hz. Supplementary speech-recording QA separate from timed calls.
protocol.optimization_decision: Consider the host-specific load supported only when paired services and per-direction media qualify. Describe CPU and memory effects separately and whether all primary pair ratios agree; no production latency SLO set by owner.
protocol.preflight: Older reference executable 16 calls x15 s at 2 calls/s completed all. First meter tone attempt exited before signaling because the launcher opened its exclusive log before executing sipbot; corrected env placement and retained attempt. Verified tone2 and real RTP meter output before timing.
